name: Bogád (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over green, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bogád (a quartered shield with a church, the Hungarian red and white bars, a cross and a plough) with a scroll inscribed BOGÁD above.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
